svg.title: Price the Specific Result
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-ai-product-price-reference-points; chapter number: 2; title: Price the Specific Result; subtitle: Beginner downloads, edited PDFs, and a resource-app bundle carry different practitioner price recommendations.; caption: Baddie In Business suggests $9–$27 beginner downloads. Richard Yu recommends $27–$47 for an edited, pain-specific PDF. Nathan Nazareth demonstrates a $39 one-time guide, member area, and AI resource-app offer.; assumptions note: Baddie In Business and Richard Yu provide range endpoints, not observed price distributions. Each endpoint is shown separately with identical minimum, maximum, and reference values; none is asserted to be a statistical typical price.; note: Nathan Nazareth puts the offer before the product and recommends testing the published app through a real credit-card purchase after functional cleanup.; chart type: horizontal_bars; unit: USD per offer; fixed reference points; bars: label: Baddie beginner lower endpoint; min: 9; max: 9; typical: 9; display: $9, lower end of $9–$27; label: Baddie beginner upper endpoint; min: 27; max: 27; typical: 27; display: $27, upper end of $9–$27; label: Richard Yu PDF lower endpoint; min: 27; max: 27; typical: 27; display: $27, lower end of $27–$47; label: Richard Yu PDF upper endpoint; min: 47; max: 47; typical: 47; display: $47, upper end of $27–$47; label: Nathan Nazareth resource-app bundle; min: 39; max: 39; typical: 39; display: $39 one-time
